options.label: Apply Bridge, Rail & Tunnel fixes
options.help: Fixes bridges, piers, ramps, divided highways, railway crossings, tunnel portals, multi-bore tunnel clearance, and lane transitions. Click Save, click Start, then restart BeamNG.Earth.

options.label: Enable 1-hotkey spot reporter (Ctrl+Shift+B)
options.help: Press Ctrl+Shift+B while driving to send a quick screenshot and map location without pausing.

options.label: Notify when my reported spots are fixed
options.help: Shows a quiet one-time corner notice at launch when a spot you reported with Ctrl+Shift+B is fixed in an update.

options.label: Notify when an add-on update is available
options.help: Checks once at launch for a newer release of Bridge, Rail & Tunnel Fixes and shows a quiet corner notice.

options.label: Spot report category
options.help: Default category used when pressing Ctrl+Shift+B (takes effect right away without restarting).

options.label: Setup action
options.help: Choose Restore original app, click Save, click Start, and restart BeamNG.Earth to uninstall.
